div.head: Cn 1018
div.ab: And æghwilc cristen man do swa him þearf is. gime his cristendomes georne. 7 gewunige gelomlice. to his scrifte. 7 unforwandodlice his synna gecyðe. 7 geornlice bete. swa swa him man tæce.

And every Christian man shall do as he ought, have diligent concern for his Christian faith, go often to confession and freely confess his sins, and zealously make amends as they are prescribed for him.
